brand_notes.fabric: brands.json's brand-level string is 'Cordura / TPU-laminate combination with welded seams'. This is not confirmed for this catalogue slice, and is contradicted for two products. The current WP bikepacking line (Handlebar Pack Boa WP, Seat Pack Boa WP, Multi Frame Pack WP, Top Tube Pack WP) all state 'Polyamide 73%, Polyester 27%' with welded seams on their own spec pages - a PA/PES blend, and EVOC never uses the word Cordura for this line (Cordura is a specific licensed fabric brand, not a generic description, so it should not be asserted without the maker actually saying it). Two products break from that PA/PES figure entirely: Frame Pack WP Classic (an older-generation product on evocsports.us, distinct URL pattern from the newer .../products/*-wp lines) specs '140/500D Shantung and water-repellent P200D', and Downtube Pack WP 1.2 specs '100% polyester (waterproof PU)'. Corrected description used per product below rather than the blanket brand string.
brand_notes.method: evocsports.com/.us are Shopify stores; a plain WebFetch returns the marketing copy and spec bullet list fine, but real product photos are not present in the rendered fetch. Appending '.json' to any /products/<handle> URL returns Shopify's public product JSON with a full 'images' array of CDN URLs - much more reliable than scraping HTML for image filenames (VAUDE's approach). Used that for every EVOC product.
brand_notes.rigid_soft: The two BOA-branded packs (Handlebar Pack Boa WP 5, Seat Pack Boa WP 6) dock to a rigid, BOA-dial-tensioned plastic bracket that clamps directly to the bar or the saddle rails - the fabric body itself is a soft rolltop tube, but the dial cinches it hard against the mount so it does not sway or sag once tightened, unlike a velcro-only mount. Frame Pack WP, Multi Frame Pack WP, and Top Tube Pack WP are semi-rigid foam-backed panel bags that hold a fixed wedge/half-moon shape on their own. Downtube Pack WP 1.2 is the one genuinely soft, floppy rolltop pouch in this set - velcro/TPU-strap mounted only, no rigid dock or internal stiffener.

products.name: EVOC Handlebar Pack Boa WP 5
products.dims_raw: evocsports.com: 'Measures 30 x 15 x 15 cm', volume 5L (a 2.5L variant of the same product also exists, not modeled here). No range given.
products.dims_note: Single fixed figures, no maker range. Round cross-section tube so wid=hgt=15 (diameter) as with other rolltop dry-bag products in this catalogue; len=30 is the tube's long axis along the bar.

geometry.notes: Straight fabric tube, rolls closed independently at both ends per maker copy ('roll-in ends for adaptable volume') and confirmed in the studio photo, which shows a finished roll-fold with buckle visible at each end. Rigid black BOA bracket sits across the top-centre of the bag, not a separate cage - the fabric is captured directly under the bracket's two strap arms.

details.fabric: Polyamide 73% / Polyester 27%, welded seams - see brand_notes.fabric (not Cordura)
details.notes_unschematized: Elastic cord criss-crossing the top of the bag for extra gear lash-up, visible in both photos; not modeled in the straps[] vocabulary.

mount.notes: BOA Fit System dial tensions two strap arms directly against the bar - rigid once dialed in, no separate cage plate. Maker states it fits MTB through road bar diameters. No clearance figure published.

products.name: EVOC Seat Pack Boa WP 6
products.dims_raw: evocsports.com: 'Measures 35 x 14 x 14 cm', volume 6L, weight 450g. No range given.
products.dims_note: Single fixed figures, no maker range. len=35 is nose-to-tail (matches the photo's clearly elongated wedge); wid/hgt (14/14) are equal in the maker's own figures even though the photographed cross-section is a flattened wedge, not round - taken at face value since there is no way to independently split them from the studio photo alone.

geometry.notes: Wedge tapering from a squared nose (rigid BOA rail-clamp bracket with a moulded rubber saddle-rail pad) back to a rolled, buckled tail. One wide webbing compression strap wraps the mid-body girth in addition to the rail clamp.

details.fabric: Polyamide 73% / Polyester 27%, welded seams - see brand_notes.fabric (not Cordura)
details.notes_unschematized: Elastic bungee cord across the top of the nose for extra gear, visible in both photos; not modeled in straps[]. Soft rubber pad protects the saddle rails at the clamp.

mount.notes: BOA dial tensions the rail clamp directly (maker copy: 'quick-fix mounting'), so the nose holds rigid; the tail is only girth-strapped so it can sag marginally under a full load. No clearance figure published.

products.name: EVOC Frame Pack WP
products.dims_raw: evocsports.us: '15 x 47.5 x 5.5 cm'. Product is sold in two capacities, 1.5L and 3.5L, but the page gives only this one dims string - it is not clear whether it is shared across both sizes or is specific to one. Weight given separately per size (1.5L: 204g; 3.5L: 318g/295g depending on color).
products.dims_note: Mapped Width(47.5, fore-aft under the top tube) to len, Depth(5.5) to wid, Height(15) to hgt, matching the photographed half-moon panel proportions. Catalog entry states 3.5L so that capacity was kept, but I could not confirm from the page whether 47.5x5.5x15 is the 3.5L bag's own figure or a shared spec across both sizes - flagged rather than silently assumed.

geometry.notes: Semi-rigid half-moon frame-triangle panel, flat/padded on the frame-facing side, gently domed on the outward face. A diagonal zip near the nose end (upper-left in the studio photo) opens a smaller pocket - maker copy describes 'two main compartments with partition' and 'a dedicated nutrition compartment' but the main-compartment opening mechanism itself is not clearly identifiable in the two photos available, so it is not asserted here.

closure.hardware: zip pull near the nose, matched to body color

details.fabric: 140/500D Shantung with water-repellent P200D coating - an older-generation spec, distinct from the rest of this catalogue slice; see brand_notes.fabric
details.notes_unschematized: Maker calls this an 'Easy 5-Point Mounting System' - 3 top-rail velcro loops plus 2 more (nose and tail) accounts for the 5 points; 'included protective stickers prevent scratches' on the frame, not modeled.

mount.notes: Semi-rigid panel, holds its own shape once the 5-point velcro system is cinched. No clearance figure published.

products.name: EVOC Multi Frame Pack WP
products.dims_raw: This product is sold in S and M sizes on one page. I was able to directly confirm S from the page text: 'Measures 5 x 21 x 9.5 cm, Volume 0.8L, Weight 80g'. The M variant's dims/volume text is rendered client-side on size selection and did not appear in either a WebFetch or a raw curl of the page; Shopify's product.json confirmed M's weight as 100g (vs S's 80g) but carries no dimension metafield. The catalog's existing entry (this record) uses len 24.5 / wid 5 / hgt 11 cm at 1.2L for what would be the M size, which is plausible (scaling S's dims by the 80g->100g weight ratio lands close to those numbers) but is NOT a figure I re-read from the maker this pass.
products.dims_note: Carried forward unchanged from the existing catalog record per the 'do not invent' rule - I could not re-verify the M variant's dims from the maker this pass, only its weight. If a future pass finds the true M spec table, it should replace this.

geometry.notes: Small semi-rigid half-moon panel, same family styling as the Frame Pack WP - front zip pocket, foam-backed flat frame-facing side. Photographed unit is unclear whether it is the S or M size (Shopify serves the same 'M' image set for both by default); geometry description should be treated as indicative for the line, not size-specific.

closure.hardware: matched-color zip with a small pull loop

details.fabric: Polyamide 73% / Polyester 27%, welded seams - see brand_notes.fabric (not Cordura)
details.notes_unschematized: Velcro straps are cuttable-to-length and maker states they can be run vertically or horizontally on the frame for versatile mounting; transparent frame-protection strips included.

mount.notes: Semi-rigid panel, velcro-only mount but holds shape. No clearance figure published.

products.name: EVOC Top Tube Pack WP
products.dims_raw: evocsports.com: 'Measures 20 x 8.5 x 5 cm', volume 0.8L, weight 90g. No range given.
products.dims_note: Single fixed figures, no maker range. len=20 (fore-aft along top tube), wid=5 (thickness), hgt=8.5 (top-to-bottom), matching the photographed wedge proportions.

geometry.notes: Small structured box, slightly taller at the nose than the tail. A raised welded storm-flap runs the length of the top ridge, covering the zip beneath it.

closure.hardware: one-handed pull with a cord loop tab; storm-flap over the zip

details.fabric: Polyamide 73% / Polyester 27%, welded seams - see brand_notes.fabric (not Cordura)
details.notes_unschematized: Velcro straps are individually adjustable/cuttable; a bolt-on mount is also offered on frames with mounting bosses, not modeled as a separate mount option.

mount.notes: Rigid structured box, no sag. No clearance figure published.

products.name: EVOC Downtube Pack WP 1.2
products.dims_raw: evocsports.us: '2.8 x 11.8 x 3.1 inches (7 x 30 x 8 cm)', volume 1.2L, weight 70g. No range given.
products.dims_note: Single fixed figures, no maker range. len=30 (tube long axis along the down tube), wid=8/hgt=7 (near-round cross-section), matching the photographed cylindrical roll.

geometry.notes: Soft rolltop fabric tube, the only genuinely floppy (non-structured) bag in this set - see brand_notes.rigid_soft. Two moulded rubber/TPU mounting pads with slotted strap channels sit along the top of the tube for the frame straps, flattening that face slightly against the down tube.

closure.hardware: side-release buckle; maker copy: 'tightens when partially filled to prevent rattling'

details.fabric: 100% polyester, waterproof PU coating, PFAS-free - see brand_notes.fabric (not Cordura, not the Polyamide/Polyester blend used elsewhere in this catalogue slice)
details.notes_unschematized: Anti-slip backing pad under the mounting straps prevents sliding on rough terrain per maker copy; 'universal frame mounting, no bosses needed'.

mount.notes: Velcro/TPU strap mount only, no rigid dock - softest-mounted bag in this brand, can sag slightly more than the structured panel bags. No clearance figure published.
